commands.readmeDescription: Display saved CPU registers: `PC=xxxx A=xx X=xx Y=xx SP=xx NV-BDIZC`

notes: Default: 8 lines (64 bytes). Remembers position for continuation.
commands.readmeDescription: Hex + ASCII memory dump (8 bytes/line); bare `M` continues from last address

notes: Default: 20 lines. Remembers position for continuation.
commands.readmeDescription: Disassemble 65C02 instructions (20 lines default); supports the full WDC 65C02 + Rockwell instruction set

commands.summary: Fill memory range with a byte value
commands.readmeDescription: Fill memory range with a byte value
Transfer (copy) a memory block; handles overlapping regions

commands.summary: Search for byte pattern in memory range
notes: Prints address of each match on its own line.
commands.readmeDescription: Hunt (search) for a byte pattern in a range

notes: Compares [addr1,addr2] with block at addr3, prints differing addresses.
commands.readmeDescription: Compare two memory regions; prints differing addresses

commands.summary: Go (JMP to address with full register restore via RTI)
notes: If addr given, sets BRK_PCL/PCH. Restores A, X, Y, P, SP via RTI.
Program runs until BRK returns to monitor or forever.
commands.readmeDescription: Go — JMP to address (or saved PC); restores all registers via RTI

commands.summary: Call subroutine and return to monitor on RTS
notes: Pushes monitor return address, restores A/X/Y, JMPs to target.
When target does RTS, saves registers and re-enters monitor.
commands.readmeDescription: JSR — call a subroutine; RTS returns to the monitor with register display

commands.syntax: ; PC xxxx A xx X xx Y xx SP xx P xx
notes: Any subset, any order. Labels: PC, A, X, Y, SP, P
commands.readmeSyntax: ; PC xxxx A xx X xx ...
commands.readmeDescription: Modify saved registers (any subset, any order)

commands.summary: Load from CF (with quoted filename) or XModem (without)
notes: CF path:     L "FILENAME" [ADDR] — load file to addr (default $0800)
Serial path: L [ADDR]            — receive via XModem to addr (default $0800)
commands.readmeDescription: Load from CompactFlash (with filename) or XModem (without) to address (default `$0800`). Loading at the default address lets `X` hand the program straight to BASIC, ready to `RUN`

commands.summary: Save to CF (with quoted filename) or XModem (without)
notes: CF path:     S "FILENAME" ADDR1 ADDR2 — save [addr1,addr2) to file
Serial path: S ADDR1 ADDR2            — send [addr1,addr2) via XModem
commands.readmeDescription: Save to CompactFlash (with filename) or XModem (without)
List current disk's directory (prints `DISK n` header)
Number conversion — hex (`$xx`), decimal (`+ddd`), or binary (`%bbbb`) input shown in all three bases

commands.summary: Select / report the current CF disk bank
commands.syntax: # NN   (hex disk 00-FF selects); # alone reports the current disk
commands.readmeDescription: Select CF disk bank `NN` (hex 00–FF); `#` alone reports the current disk
